finding.expected: Enforce one exact v1 field shape for policy and persisted profile documents, reject duplicate YAML keys and unknown fields deterministically, restrict source attribution to the canonical allowed values, and add focused regressions for duplicate keys, extra fields, and invalid source labels. Preserve opaque model identifiers, current TASK-061 defaults, historical terminals with no profile, and all TASK-163 boundaries.
finding.issue: The execution-profile v1 contracts are still permissive rather than strict. parse_execution_profile_policy accepts unknown top-level and per-executor fields and uses yaml.safe_load, so duplicate YAML keys are silently collapsed instead of failing closed. parse_execution_profile likewise accepts unknown fields and accepts arbitrary non-empty model_source/effort_source labels even though the canonical contract defines REPOSITORY_DEFAULT and EXPLICIT attribution. This leaves multiple noncanonical document shapes able to deserialize as the same operational profile and does not satisfy the strict single-policy/single-profile contract required by AC1.
